value.rationale: The natural ecology parameter-selection problem asks whether any partial germination achieves a finite two-year descendant advantage. The proof replaces an approximate numerical survival floor with an exact universal 4/5 barrier and provides a complete closed-form ratio-dependent feasible region and structural cutoff. This is a nontrivial mathematically motivated classification, not a fixed example, despite deriving from established site-recapture equations.
